jobs.description: Requisition ID: 73223 About Whirlpool Corporation Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.-based manufacturer of kitchen and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid, JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported approximately $16 billion in annual net sales - close to 90% of which were in the Americas - 41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com. ## The team you will be a part of The Tax team ensures that the organization meets its tax obligations and objectives and complies with all relevant laws and regulations. Activities may include undertaking research; evaluating the legality and tax effectiveness of current and future business activities; preparing and submitting tax returns, tax declarations, and other required reports; maintaining tax records; and corresponding with external tax agencies or consultants. ## This role in summary Leads indirect tax consulting and advisory for Brazilian operations— from manufacturing and distribution to B2B and D2C sales channels, including operations in the Manaus Free Trade Zone (ZFM). Reporting to the Indirect Taxes Senior Manager, this position provides specialized technical guidance on IBS, CBS, Imposto Seletivo, ICMS, IPI, PIS/COFINS, ISS and any other indirect taxes, drives tax planning and incentives management, and supports business expansion and strategic initiatives across the group. The role serves as the primary technical reference for indirect taxes within the organization and the key interface with the corporate tax group, championing the innovation agenda for indirect taxes consulting through AI solutions that transform how the team works. It also serves as the main source of planning opportunities to optimize the company's operations, with a solid interaction with the Transformation Projects team under the common Senior Manager. ## group—translating complex indirect tax matters into clear, business-oriented language, while developing and training the team. ## Minimum requirements * Education: Bachelor's degree in Law. * jobs.description: Job Title: Executive Producer - Call of Duty Requisition ID: R028234 Job Description: Job Title : Executive Producer Reporting To: Senior Director of Production Department : Production Location: Santa Monica, CA Your Platform Founded in 1979, Activision has continuously disrupted the world of entertainment as a leader in the videogame industry. With a history of delivering iconic game changers -- like Pitfall® , Tony Hawk®, Guitar Hero®, Crash Bandicoot™, Skylanders ™ and Call of Duty ® -- our obsession is delighting our players around the globe. Focused and committed to innovation, we consistently deliver the most beloved, engaging and successful entertainment. And while we have world-class franchises, infrastructure and resources, our success comes from a passionate, talented and diverse team of people producing greatness together. So, if you’re interested in our biggest priority, it’s our people. We’re currently driving the next era for our company and community by creating amazing experiences for fans and continuing to make Activision an inclusive place where everyone can thrive. Join us, make history. To learn more, check us out at www.activision.com , www.activisiongamesblog.com or @Activision on Instagram, Twitter, Facebook and LinkedIn. Your Mission Activision Publishing is currently looking for an Executive Producer to join the Call of Duty franchise production team. We are looking for an individual who has a passion and proven track record of leading production initiatives. As Executive Producer, you will manage production initiatives on one or multiple projects across various platforms from both a business and publishing perspective. You will partner with both internal and external studios in a wide range of areas to achieve franchise initiatives as well as attain financial and schedule goals. This entails day-to-day involvement with the development teams and key publishing stakeholders throughout all phases of development, including pre-production, production, submission, and release. Specific duties include: working with teams to build out initiative requirements, goals, and roadmaps; ensure milestones are delivered on-time and the game meets quality standards; help maintain creative vision; track overall development; and work closely with all developers and cross-functional groups to deliver initiatives, activations, and digital content to meet all project and franchise goals. You will guide and advance Call of Duty as you work with all Studios and Business Partners. This role will continuously iterate on best practices across all the franchise games, adapting with the business. You will be a project leader, and work in with multiple cross-functional groups, ranging from Activision executive leadership to development studios, and use your experience on the front lines to improve production and organizational processes, as well as drive key franchise initiatives with both developers and internal department leads. This position is based in our Santa Monica, California office and follows an in-office work model of four days per week. Working arrangements may evolve based on business needs. Your responsibilities will include Manage and track game development with internal / external studios across all SKUs of production initiatives tied to a mainline product and its digital life-cycle. Support the creation, development, and execution of production initiatives, projects, pathways, and overall plan; continue to provide supervision and support through full operations life-cycle Collaborate with business partners and studios to provide players with a steady stream of compelling features, content, and events Partner with monetization and analytics teams to understand the game’s status and plan updates accordingly Act as primary point of contact with Game Development Studios, 1st Parties, Marketing, PR, Operations, Sales, Supply Chain, Licensors, and external contractors across project initiatives Partner with Marketing to execute plans for the product lines, brands, and lines of business Partner with Developers to ensure specific game features are tied to overall title positioning and goals Be an internal and external advocate for the product and support as needed at trade shows and PR events. Coach and develop staff to ensure growth and expand the talent base Create a culture that promotes collaboration, continuous feedback, support and empowerment. Set clear goals for the team and hold employees accountable for deliverables; recognize and reward employees for strong performance Establish model behavior that supports Activision’s standards of professionalism, integrity, and ethics Provide creative and executional direction to development studios to improve product quality and drive franchise innovation. Ensure the titles and franchise maintain or exceed creative and technical objectives with each release What you bring to the table Proven Executive Producer with either internal development or publishing experience who delivers projects to quality, on time and budget. 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role); experience with First Person Shooters or Online FPS preferred with 3+ years of experience at Senior Producer level or above. The ability to identify risks early and often and suggest mitigation strategies that are thought through and take into account multiple paths to a solution. A Leader of People. Be prepared to lead, mentor and develop future leaders. You are knowledgeable about games and trends in the industry ranging from other competitive FPS titles, Monetization, E-Sports and other ways games are expanding beyond the core mainline experience. Collaborator & Communicator You speak other languages; specifically, the languages of marketing, PR, Sales, QA, Customer Service, Localizations, Tech, Monetization, CRM, etc. Producing the game is only part of the job. You’ll collaborate with a wide variety of groups and people. Experience effectively collaborating with internal teams and development studios within the video game industry. You will only be as successful as your relationship with the development teams allows. You will be the main point of contact for one of the biggest entertainment franchises in the world and requires best in class and timely communications across all mediums (emails, phone, meetings, presentations, etc.) Gamer Who Knows How to Make a Game Great You are passionate about making video games. Ability to evaluate and judge gameplay in its current state and its trajectory towards close. Can identify what plays and looks good and how to drive improvements toward greatness by leveraging qualitative assessments. Experience identifying the strengths and weakness in a game and knowing when to marshal resources to lean into strengths or address weaknesses. Strategist with the Skills to Execute Strong business/financial acumen and understanding of current business models in gaming Never afraid to roll up your sleeves to get the job done Facilitator who clear roadblocks in front of your team or the development team Able to juggle competing priorities and timelines Able to break down impossible tasks and make them possible through ingenuity, creativity, and effort. The Skills & Experience we’re looking for: Bachelor’s Degree or higher education degree preferred 10+ years of experience in the gaming industry (in a production role) 3+ years of experience at Sr. Producer level or above Experience shipping 3+ high quality titles Experience shipping on Xbox, PlayStation, and PC platforms. Experience with online FPS games preferred. Our World At Activision, we strive to create the most iconic brands in gaming and entertainment. We’re driven by our mission to deliver unrivaled gaming experiences for the world to enjoy, together. We are home to some of the most beloved entertainment franchises including Call of Duty®, Crash Bandicoot™, Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™, and Guitar Hero®. As a leading worldwide developer, publisher and distributor of interactive entertainment and products, our “press start” is simple: delight hundreds of millions of players around the world with innovative, fun, thrilling, and engaging entertainment experiences. We’re not just looking back at our decades-long legacy; we’re forging ahead to keep advancing gameplay with some of the most popular titles and sophisticated technology in the world. We have bold ambitions to create the most inclusive company as we know our success comes from the passionate, creative, and diverse teams within our organization. We’re in the business of delivering fun and unforgettable entertainment for our player community to enjoy. And our future opportunities have never been greater — this could be your opportunity to level up. Ready to Activate Your Future? We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the games industry. Not sure you meet all qualifications? Let us decide! Research shows that women and members of other under-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! jobs.description:
Riot Games was established in 2006 by entrepreneurial gamers who believe that player-focused development leads to exceptional games. In 2009, Riot released its debut title League of Legends to critical and player acclaim. Since then, Riot has expanded its portfolio and studios globally, continuing to create games that inspire and connect players around the world.

That’s where you come in.

As a Senior Manager, Game Production for one of Riot’s Unpublished R&D products, you’ll lead the production effort in our Singapore studio, orchestrating the local development team and ensuring strong alignment with the senior game leadership based in Los Angeles. You’ll be the team captain responsible for translating the game’s creative vision into clear, actionable plans, maintaining the health of both the collaboration and the local production organization.

Your role is to foster a cohesive, high-performing team environment where creative excellence and operational discipline meet. You’ll drive delivery predictability, strengthen cross-studio communication, and ensure that our Singapore team contributes effectively to the overall success of the project.

Responsibilities:

• Lead the Singapore production organization, aligning team goals and priorities with the game’s vision, strategy, and milestones set by the Los Angeles leadership team.
• Serve as the primary accountable owner for collaboration health, ensuring clear communication, mutual trust, and smooth integration between studios.
• Drive operational excellence by designing and maintaining scalable production systems, workflows, and accountability rituals that enable sustainable and predictable delivery.
• Cascade strategic direction from senior game leadership into clear objectives and execution plans for Singapore-based teams.
• Oversee cross-disciplinary coordination (art, design, engineering, QA, etc.) to ensure efficient collaboration and timely delivery of features, prototypes, and content.
• Assess and manage risks, proactively addressing production challenges, dependencies, and resourcing needs.
• Monitor production and collaboration health metrics, fostering transparency, alignment, and continuous improvement across all teams.
• Support people management efforts in partnership with discipline leads, ensuring clear goals, career growth, and strong team morale.
• Represent the Singapore team in strategic discussions, status updates, and cross-studio alignment meetings, ensuring both clarity and advocacy for local needs.
• Model Riot’s values and leadership expectations, fostering psychological safety, inclusion, and a feedback-driven culture across teams.
• Champion a player-focused mindset and be the voice of the player

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of senior leadership experience in game production, operations, or project management within gaming, including experience as a manager of managers and shipping or supporting AAA titles.
• Led production organizations of 30+ people or multiple teams, with ownership of staffing, priorities, capacity, and delivery.
• Strong experience managing co development or distributed development across studios or locations, including ownership, milestones, dependencies, and handovers between internal teams and external partners.
• Experience translating creative vision into scope, milestones, resource plans, and deliverables.
• Strong track record in risk management, capacity planning, and holding team leaders accountable for delivery.
• Strong understanding of Agile, Scrum, or Kanban, with experience adapting production processes to R&D environments.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, including resolving conflicts and aligning senior creative, technical, and business leaders.

Desired Qualifications

• 2+ years leading large scale collaboration between internal and external studios.
• Experience shipping or supporting MMO or live service titles.
• Led teams through uncertainty, changing priorities, and rapid iteration in early development.
• Managed outsourcing partners against agreed scope, quality, milestones, and deadlines.

Our Perks:

• Full relocation support
• Full health insurance for you, your spouse and children
• Open paid time off
• Retirement benefits with company matching
• Life insurance, parental leave, plus short-term and long-term disability
• Play Fund so you can broaden and deepen your knowledge of our players and community through games
• We will double down on your donations of time and money to non-profits

El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico

Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.
• Capacitar a gerentes y asociados en temas de prevención, primeros auxilios y protocolos de emergencia.
• Elaborar y entregar bitácoras diarias de actividad al equipo de liderazgo del sitio.
• Generar un análisis mensual de todos los incidentes de salud y seguridad ocurridos en el sitio.
• Asistir y participar de forma constante en las reuniones de inicio de turno ("stand-up").
• Rotar turnos según las necesidades operativas del sitio. Este puesto es presencial y no admite trabajo remoto.

A day in the life
Reportarás directamente al Gerente de WHS (Seguridad, Salud y Bienestar en el Trabajo). Serás el representante médico asignado a un sitio específico, donde administrarás la sala de AmCare: atenderás casos de prevención de salud ocupacional y emergencias médicas, gestionarás el inventario y la adquisición de insumos médicos, e inspeccionarás periódicamente el equipo de emergencia (DEA, camillas, botiquines). Serás responsable de mantener la confidencialidad de la información médica de los asociados y de garantizar el acceso controlado a la sala de AmCare.

About the team
Cultura de equipo incluyente
En Amazon abrazamos nuestras diferencias y estamos comprometidos con seguir fortaleciendo nuestra cultura de inclusión. Ofrecemos experiencias de aprendizaje anuales y continuas. La cultura de inclusión de Amazon se refuerza en nuestros 14 Principios de Liderazgo, que recuerdan a los integrantes del equipo buscar perspectivas diversas, aprender y ser curiosos, y ganarse la confianza.
Equilibrio entre vida personal y laboral
Creemos que lograr el equilibrio adecuado entre tu vida personal y profesional es fundamental para la felicidad y la realización a lo largo de la vida. Ofrecemos flexibilidad de horario y te animamos a encontrar tu propio equilibrio entre tu trabajo y tu vida personal.
Mentoría y crecimiento profesional
Nuestro equipo está dedicado a apoyar a los nuevos integrantes. Contamos con una amplia variedad de niveles de experiencia y antigüedad, y estamos construyendo un entorno que celebra el intercambio de conocimiento y la mentoría. Nos importa tu crecimiento profesional y buscamos asignar proyectos con base en lo que ayude a cada integrante del equipo a desarrollarse como un profesional más completo.

Over time you will work more broadly across our observability stack centered on Datadog or a similar platform, integrating complementary open source and cloud native technologies to meet strategic business goals. You will be a hands-on contributor who improves reliability, accelerates troubleshooting, and enables data driven engineering through first class observability.
